outcome: Number of intraoperative and postoperative additional doses
cohort: 2303 patients undergoing one of seven surgical procedures
finding: Compliance with nationwide ABP guidelines needs pronounced improvement, especially regarding the time interval between injection and incision and the molecule prescribed.
mod_finding: In cesarean sections, compliance with antibiotic prophylaxis guidelines needs improvement, particularly in the timing of administration relative to incision and the choice of antimicrobial agent.
